Am I really to be the last[XENO:n ]
ruler of the High Entia?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Melia...I...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]In fact, even calling me the[XENO:n ]
ruler is a bit of a joke.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I'm the empress of a city of one.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You weren't the only one with[XENO:n ]
Homs heritage.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Reach out to the remaining High[XENO:n ]
Entia. Rebuild the city together.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・Easier said than done!/・Do you think it's possible? ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Rebuilding Achamoth is nonsense.[XENO:n ]
It's completely impossible.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Sorry, Melia. I might have[XENO:n ]
seemed a bit too eager there.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But I don't want you to give up.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]I understand what you're saying.[XENO:n ]
But...I can't, Shulk...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Is that really how you feel?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・Yes./・Well...not exactly. ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]But...that isn't you![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]The Melia I know has a lot more[XENO:n ]
confidence in herself than that.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]How can I be confident[XENO:n ]
in myself?![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I failed to save those close to me.[XENO:n ]
I let them die...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You think someone like that can[XENO:n ]
rebuild an entire city?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]So...what? You're just going to[XENO:n ]
forget you're even a High Entia?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Live the rest of your life[XENO:n ]
as a Homs?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:jaw jaw=off ]...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:jaw jaw=on ][XENO:act act=EVT2 ]No... I will not do that.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Whatever you're going to do, you[XENO:n ]
don't have to rush your decision.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Take some time. Think about it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I'll be here, ready to listen.[XENO:n ]
Whatever choice you make.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]I don't know the path I will take.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I need time to think...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]However, I will tell you as soon[XENO:n ]
as I know.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I'll look forward to it.[XENO:n ]
No hurry, though![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Thank you, Shulk.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I am resolved in my decision[XENO:n ]
to ascend the throne.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Then what's wrong?[XENO:n ]
You'll be a great ruler.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]But what about those I let down?[XENO:n ]
All those close to me I lost?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]How can I, a failure to my people,[XENO:n ]
rebuild an entire city?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]If anyone can rally the people[XENO:n ]
again, it's you, Melia.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]It'll take time and a lot of effort,[XENO:n ]
but if you build it, they will come.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]Shulk![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I just remembered Juujuu is helping[XENO:n ]
to reconstruct Colony 6.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yeah. You could learn a few[XENO:n ]
tips from him![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You'll get Achamoth back on its[XENO:n ]
feet before you know it![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Thank you so much, Shulk![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]It's settled. I shall begin as soon[XENO:n ]
as our current mission is over.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Of course! I'll help you out.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You'll be fine. I know it! No one's[XENO:n ]
tougher than you, Melia.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]No challenge seems beyond[XENO:n ]
reach when you talk about it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]When I look into your eyes, I feel[XENO:n ]
so sure about myself.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]You do? Well, thanks![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Shulk... When Achamoth is rebuilt,[XENO:n ]
I have a...personal mission.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Really? What are you gonna do?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]I want to see if I can find any[XENO:n ]
relatives of my mother.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]My real mother, that is.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]You mean the...Second Consort?[XENO:n ]
She was your birth mother, right?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]Yes.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I only have a few memories of our[XENO:n ]
time spent in the Imperial Villa.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Then we can look together![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・You'll...look for them with me?/・I can't ask that of you. ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Are you sure? I mean...[XENO:n ]
I don't want to pressure you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]You don't even have to ask.[XENO:n ]
I'd love to meet your family.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]It might take some time to track[XENO:n ]
them down...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Then let's ask Fiorung and Reyn![XENO:n ]
The four of us can go![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Then we'll be sure to find them.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Well...OK, Shulk.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Another adventure with my friends.[XENO:n ]
It would be most enjoyable![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]We'll always be your friends.[XENO:n ]
Even after you return home.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I'm glad. Thank you, Shulk.[XENO:n ]
You're a good friend.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]It might take some time to track[XENO:n ]
them down. I'll go alone.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Why? The two of us could[XENO:n ]
find them in half the time![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You should be with Fiorung.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]She's still not completely well.[XENO:n ]
It's the right thing to do.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT13 ]But...what about your mother's[XENO:n ]
relatives?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]I'll find them. Don't worry[XENO:n ]
about me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Thank you, Shulk.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT15 ]OK. Whatever you say, Melia.[XENO:n ]
But remember this...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]When you go back to Achamoth,[XENO:n ]
I'll still be your friend.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Any time you need me, just let me[XENO:n ]
know. I'll be there for you, Melia.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]I will, Shulk. Thank you[XENO:n ]
for everything.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
